0022600194.text: The Rockets, 7-2 and first in the Southwest, make their 10th game of the season on the road after a loss in their last outing, while the Suns are 1-4, have dropped three straight, and sit 12th in the West. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Rockets swept all four meetings in 2025-26, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
